blocked_sentences: This creature can block only creatures with flying.

needs.what: a static on a creature restricting which attackers IT may block, by a filter over the attacker ("this creature can block only creatures with flying"): an `affects` naming the blocker (self_only) and an `attackers` filter (e.g. keywords: [flying]) read on the attacker's derived characteristics in combat.can_block
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `block_restriction` is the mirror image: it sits on the ATTACKER and filters which blockers may block it (block_restrictions(state, attacker_oid) matches `affects` against the attacker). `cant_block` forbids blocking outright with no attacker filter. No keyword covers it (shadow is two-way and about shadow only). combat.can_block has no check of a blocker-side static against the attacker's qualities
